text: Paper and book atlas / 1993 Dynamics of Conductive/Cooling Fronts: Cloud Implosion and Thermal Solitons Ferrara & Shchekinov · 1993 ApJ 417, 595 Reference listed · scope proposed Conductive and radiative interfaces admit static and steady fronts, cloud compression, and soliton-like solutions. Scope in this archive. Start with planar static/steady front equations, boundary heat fluxes, and the mechanical analogy. Select a small ODE benchmark after auditing the heat-loss law, conductivity, and pressure/flow assumptions. Cloud implosion simulations are a separate, optional scope. Source review: Author preprint abstract and bibliography checked; equations, target figures, and simulation inputs require a dedicated audit. Source notes and related resources.
